content: Impossible is not a declaration. It's a dare. Impossible is potential. Impossible is temporary. Impossible is nothing.
author: Muhammad Ali
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Reminding yourself of your mortality is not morbid; it is the most clarifying lens available to human consciousness. When you remember that your days are strictly numbered, petty resentments and trivial anxieties evaporate.

In Muhammad Ali's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Death gives urgency and sweetness to every ordinary afternoon. Because this day will never come again, the way you spend your attention right now is of monumental significance.
reflectionPrompt: Where does your life require a quiet act of courage from you before this week ends?
